title: 第8章 过得硬的连队，过得硬的兵
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “到底，到底还有多久才能到啊？”“该死的新兵连，究竟在哪儿啊？”“奶奶的，咱们是来当兵的，怎么整的跟逃难的一样.......”野外小道上，新兵们像是羊拉屎一样稀稀拉拉，气喘吁吁的往前跑。原先从火车上下来，大家以为到了部队，也就到了所谓的新兵连。却没想到，真正的目的地距离竟然这么远，足足跑了半个多小时却连个影子都没见着。每次有人询问排头的周凯东，到底还有多久才能到，得到的回答永远都是：快了快了，就到了。野外的道路崎岖难走，不像是水泥路或柏油路那般平整，战士们背着行囊，穿的还都是解放胶鞋，自然是硌脚又难受。“不，不行了，我得歇会儿......”孔垄背着行囊，扶着路边一棵树，大口大口喘着粗气。还真被陆阳给说中了，他这一身死肌肉，跑起来负担要比其他人大得多。在健身房里头，他永远都是器械区最靓的仔，因为担心掉肌肉，跑步机和椭圆机这类有氧器械，他碰都不碰。但尽管如此，孔垄的状态还是要比陆阳好上一些，毕竟他是有一定运动锻炼基础的。而陆阳真正系统化锻炼的时间并不久，尽管有系统相助，但因为底子过于薄弱，短期内想要有大突破几乎不太可能。“要不要帮一把？”孔垄性子豪爽，主动伸手想要帮陆阳分担点重量，但却被拒绝了。陆阳甩着额头的汗，冲他挤出笑容：“谢了，不过我还是想靠自已走到终点。”虽然有系统辅助，但其实更多还是得靠自身努力，要是怕吃苦，他就不会来当兵了。总有人问，当兵苦，还是上班苦？但陆阳作为过来人，深切体会过那种被社会毒打到遍体鳞伤，碎了牙齿还得往肚子里咽的苦楚。经济上的巨大压力，交不起房租吃不起饭的窘迫，黑心老板的压榨和甩锅，永远加不完的班，还有亲朋好友的催婚......这些全方位的精神折磨，要远比身体上的疲惫，要让人绝望和窒息的多，且看不到希望。.......一小时后，众人终于陆陆续续抵达了新兵连，却也全部累的东倒西歪。陆阳浑身是汗，整个人像是洗了澡似的，状态几乎是同批新兵连最差的。没办法，底子实在太差，从小就是个药罐子，征兵体检几乎都是压着及格线过的。要不，当初陆阳说报名参军时，父母的第一反应也不会是：部队能要你吗？不过，他相信在系统的帮助下，用不了多久他就能赶上大部队，达到平均水平，然后一点点的完成反超！“都给我站好了！歪歪扭扭，东倒西歪，你们也能算兵？”连长的训斥在耳边响起，大家赶紧装模作样的站好一些。高峰冲着一排长点点头，周凯东立即放开点名册。“现在开始分班！”“张三，八班！”“李四，六班！”“丁腾飞，三班！”“.......”“孔垄，三班！”孔垄立马提着行李，跑到三班长身后。而三班长，正是兼任一排排长职务的周凯东。分班接近尾声，眼看身边新兵越来越少，迟迟没等到安排的陆阳不免有些心烦意乱。别回头给他安排去什么食堂，后勤之类的地方？“陆阳！”“到！”周凯东抬头，冲他露出冷笑。“三班！”“是！”陆阳也没想到在，自已最终竟会分到周凯东这个老阴阳人手里。落在这家伙手上，接下来三个月怕是要没有好日子过了。不过，陆阳的到来让孔垄显得十分高兴。他还挺喜欢这位南方战友的性格，很对味儿。分班结束，连长高峰再次发话：“各班班长把人带回宿舍，放下行李立即下来集合，准备前往食堂吃饭！解散！”......“一个个的，给我把那破花儿摘了！”刚进宿舍，周凯东的臭骂声就在背后响起。陆阳赶忙解开身上代表新兵入伍的大红花，往床上一丢。孔垄因为臂围过于粗壮，手忙脚乱的始终解不开，还是陆阳搭了把手。还有过于老实巴交的，竟然跑过去询问周凯东：“班长，这大红花，放哪儿啊？”周凯东被逗笑了：“来，放我口袋里？不然放我帽子里？”众新兵：“.......”周凯东见还有人磨磨唧唧的，当即大发雷霆：“立即下楼集合，别让老子重复第二遍！”噔噔噔的脚步声响起，各班新兵放下行李后快速下楼集合。吃饭不积极，脑子有问题，所有人都对入伍后的第一餐抱以极大的期待。集合完毕后，队伍便朝着食堂那边走去，过程中不断有人低声交头接耳。“不知道部队食堂伙食怎么样？”“肯定差不了，我听说入伍后第一顿，都得吃面。”“不一定吧？咱们是白天到的，又不是夜里，应该是吃正餐。”“管他吃啥，反正只要给口热乎饭吃就行，老子都快饿死了！”新兵们来到食堂台阶前原地踏步，同时调整队列状态。连长高峰站在台阶上一眼扫过去，发现好几个在望呆，还有东张西望的。“第二排那个兵，你动什么动？”“后排第三个，你嘴巴在干什么，喜欢讲话上来讲！”高峰仅仅只是抓了两三个典型，就让原本自由散漫的新兵变得严肃起来。陆阳站在队列当中，心中暗自警惕，生怕有什么地方做得不到位被抓典型。足足站了两三分钟，高峰都没再说过一句话，就这么背着手盯着下面这群新兵，用眼神给予压迫。“讲一下部队的规矩！”“到了这，你们就是一个兵，行走坐卧一言一行都必须有兵的样子！”“先前那些交头接耳，东张西望，发呆愣神的，我不想再看到第二次。再有下次，你们自已看着办！”军人说话做事讲究雷厉风行。陆阳很喜欢连长的说话方式，直接，简单，粗暴，没有那么多弯弯绕。高峰继续说：“部队吃饭之前得唱歌，这也是规矩！唱得好，有饭吃，唱不好没饭吃！”新兵们瞬间像是泄了气的皮球一样，怎么吃个饭还整这么多幺蛾子？你怎么不搞个劲歌热舞大赛，再上来跳支舞？这时，排长周凯东走上前：“这首歌叫《过得硬的连队》，我教一句，你们一句！”他双手伸出，像是乐队指挥手那样，开始用力挥舞：“过得硬的连队，过得硬的兵，过得硬的思想红彤彤，过得硬的子弹长着眼，过得硬的刺刀血染红.......”因为坐了一路火车，又跑了这么远路的缘故，大家都是有气无力的。连长虽然嘴上说的狠，但实际并没有没刁难大家。只是吩咐各班排长回去以后，认真做好教学工作。很快，饥肠辘辘的众人便满怀期待的进到食堂。可当看到餐桌上摆放的食物后，所有人都大跌眼镜.......
content_en: "How long does it take to arrive?" "Where is the damn recruit company?" "Grandma, we are here to be soldiers, why are we acting like refugees..." On the wild trail, the recruits were like sheep shitting, running forward panting.After getting off the train, everyone thought that when they arrived at the army, they would also arrive at the so-called recruit company.But I didn't expect that the real destination was so far away. After running for more than half an hour, I didn't even see a shadow.Every time someone asks Zhou Kaidong, who is at the front of the queue, how long it will take to arrive, the answer he gets is always: It’s almost there, it’s almost there.The roads in the wild are rugged and difficult to walk, and are not as smooth as cement roads or asphalt roads. The soldiers carry bags on their backs and wear Jiefang rubber shoes, which naturally hurts their feet and feels uncomfortable."No, I can't, I have to take a rest..." Kong Long was carrying his luggage and holding on to a tree on the side of the road, breathing heavily.Lu Yang really got it right. With his dead muscles, the burden of running was much greater than that of others.In the gym, he is always the most handsome guy in the equipment section. Because he is worried about losing muscle, he won't touch aerobic equipment such as treadmills and elliptical machines.But despite this, Kong Long's condition is still better than Lu Yang. After all, he has a certain foundation in sports training.Lu Yang's real systematic training was not long ago. Although there was systematic help, because his foundation was too weak, it was almost impossible to make a big breakthrough in the short term."Do you want to help?" Kong Long had a bold temper and reached out to help Lu Yang share some of the weight, but was rejected.Lu Yang shook the sweat from his forehead and smiled at him: "Thank you, but I still want to reach the finish line on my own." Although there is system assistance, in fact, more of it has to rely on his own efforts. If he was afraid of hardship, he would not join the army.People always ask, is it harder to be a soldier or to work?But as someone who has lived in the past, Lu Yang has deeply experienced the pain of being beaten by society until his body is covered with bruises, his teeth are broken, and he has to swallow it in his stomach.Huge financial pressure, the embarrassment of not being able to pay the rent and food, the oppression and blame-shifting by unscrupulous bosses, endless overtime, and the pressure of relatives and friends to get married... These all-round mental torture are far more desperate and suffocating than physical exhaustion, and there is no hope...... An hour later, everyone finally arrived at the recruit company one after another, but they were all staggering tiredly.Lu Yang was covered in sweat, as if he had taken a shower, and his condition was almost the worst among the recruits in the same batch.There was nothing I could do about it, my background was really poor. I had been a drug addict since I was a child, and almost always passed the military recruitment physical examination at the passing mark.Otherwise, when Lu Yang said he signed up to join the army, his parents' first reaction wouldn't have been: Can the army want you?However, he believes that with the help of the system, it won't be long before he can catch up with the large group, reach the average level, and then complete the overtake bit by bit!"Stand still! You are swaying and swaying, how can you be counted as a soldier?" The company commander's scolding rang in the ears, and everyone quickly pretended to stand still.Gao Feng nodded to the platoon leader, and Zhou Kaidong immediately let go of the roster."Start dividing classes now!" "Zhang San, class eight!" "Li Si, class six!" "Ding Tengfei, class three!" "..." "Kong Long, class three!" Kong Long immediately picked up his luggage and ran behind the third squad leader.The third squad leader is none other than Zhou Kaidong, who also serves as the first platoon leader.The division of classes was coming to an end. Seeing that there were fewer and fewer recruits around him, Lu Yang couldn't help but feel a little upset because he had not waited for the arrangement.Don't go back and arrange for him to go to some canteen, logistics, etc.?"Lu Yang!" "Here!" Zhou Kaidong raised his head and sneered at him."Class Three!" "Yes!" Lu Yang also didn't expect that he would eventually be assigned to Zhou Kaidong, an old hermaphrodite.If it falls into the hands of this guy, I'm afraid there will be no good life in the next three months.However, Lu Yang's arrival made Kong Long very happy.He quite liked the character of this southern comrade-in-arms, he was very suitable.After the class division, the company commander Gao Feng spoke again: "The squad leaders of each class took people back to the dormitory, put down their luggage and immediately came down to assemble, ready to go to the cafeteria for dinner! Dismissed!"... "One by one, pick those broken flowers for me!" As soon as they entered the dormitory, Zhou Kaidong's curses rang out from behind.Lu Yang quickly untied the big red flower that represented the new recruits' enlistment and threw it on the bed.Because Kong Long's arms were too thick, he was in a hurry and couldn't untie it, so it was Lu Yang who helped him.Some were too honest and honest, and even ran over to ask Zhou Kaidong: "Squad leader, where do you put this big red flower?" Zhou Kaidong was amused: "Here, put it in my pocket? Or put it in my hat?" All the recruits: "......." When Zhou Kaidong saw that there were still people chattering, he immediately became furious: "Go downstairs and assemble immediately, don't let me repeat it a second time!" The thumping footsteps sounded, and each class of recruits put down their luggage and quickly went downstairs to assemble.They are not active in eating and have brain problems. Everyone has great expectations for the first meal after joining the army.After gathering, the team walked towards the cafeteria, and people kept whispering to each other in low voices during the process."I wonder how the food in the army cafeteria is?" "It's definitely not bad. I heard that the first meal after joining the army is to eat noodles." "Not necessarily? We arrived during the day, not at night, so we should have dinner." "It doesn't matter what he eats, as long as he eats hot food, I'm almost starving to death!" The recruits came to the steps of the cafeteria and stood still, adjusting their queue status.Company commander Gao Feng stood on the steps and glanced over, finding several people staring blankly, and some looking around."That soldier in the second row, why are you moving?" "The third row in the back, what are you doing with your mouth? You like to talk!" Gao Feng only caught two or three typical examples and made the originally free and casual recruits become serious.Lu Yang stood in the queue, secretly vigilant in his heart, fearing that if he failed to do something well, he would be caught as a model.After standing for two or three minutes, Gao Feng didn't say another word. He just stared at the group of recruits below with his hands behind his back, oppressing them with his eyes."Tell me about the rules of the army!" "When you are here, you are a soldier. You must walk, sit, lie down, speak and act like a soldier!" "I don't want to see those people who were whispering to each other, looking around, and in a daze before. Next time, it's up to you!" Soldiers are very strict in what they say and do.Lu Yang liked the company commander's way of speaking very much. It was direct, simple and rough, without so many twists and turns.Gao Feng continued: "The troops must sing before eating. This is also a rule! If you sing well, you will have food to eat. If you sing poorly, you will not have food to eat!" The recruits were like deflated balls in an instant. How could they have so many troubles after just one meal?Why don't you hold a singing and dancing contest and come up and dance?At this time, the platoon leader Zhou Kaidong stepped forward: "This song is called "The Hard Company", let me teach you something, and you guys say something!" He stretched out his hands, like a band conductor, and began to wave vigorously: "The hard company, the hard soldiers, the hard thoughts are red, the hard bullets have eyes, the hard bayonets are stained with blood..." Because they took the train all the way and ran such a long distance, everyone was weak.Although the company commander said he was harsh, he actually did not make things difficult for everyone.I just asked the platoon leaders of each class to do a good job in teaching seriously after returning home.Soon, the hungry people entered the cafeteria with great expectations.But when they saw the food on the table, everyone was shocked...
